title: ICJ - Military and Paramilitary Activities in and against Nicaragua (Nicaragua v. United States of America)
excerpt: On 9 April 1984 Nicaragua filed an Application instituting proceedings against the United States of America, together with a Request for the indication of provisional measures concerning a dispute relating to responsibility for military and paramilitary activities in and against Nicaragua. On 10 May 1984 the Court made an Order indicating provisional measures.
